input: Audit route-gradient selection, loop-breaking, closure-field condition, and language-mediated coupling without replacing Delta or claiming uptake.

bridge_terms.PsiN: PsiN / Ψᴺ is the agent/runtime execution field maintained by the diagnostic IR, burden cycle, Delta events, reread, and closure checks.
bridge_terms.PsiI: PsiI / Ψᴵ is the diagnosed interlocutor noetic field inferred from discourse, profile, source-status, register pressure, and response evidence; it is not direct soul access.
bridge_terms.route_gradient: Plain ∇ is route-gradient pressure over eligible live noetic/burden/dependency/register/route field structure. It ranks release pressure only after IR, V1/routing, catalogue, and held-material gates constrain the eligible route set.
bridge_terms.loop_break: LoopBreak(∇×T) is a licensed curl-resolution submove when target-explicit ∇× over field target T remains nonzero and an owner-licensed grounding source is available.
bridge_terms.closure_field_condition: 𝒞(Ψᴺ) is a positive closure-field condition over the agent execution field: burdens are landed/integrated/held, divergence is bounded, curl is resolved or held, and the route can be reconstructed.
bridge_terms.coupling: T_lang: Ψᴺ ⇢ Ψᴵ marks the released language-mediated coupling attempt. It may perturb the diagnosed interlocutor field but does not guarantee acceptance or claim the agent controls guidance.
bridge_terms.expanded_R: R(H,Delta) rereads the whole live field after Delta events, loop-breaking attempts, and field diagnostics before STOP/HOLD/RECURSE/PARTIAL.

loop_breaking.target_loop: target loop: T is an explicit burden/dependency/register/route/collapse field target with nonzero curl
loop_breaking.grounding_source: fiṭrah, ʿaql ṣarīḥ, necessary knowledge, definition anchor, source-status correction, contradiction exposure, or another owner-licensed ground
loop_breaking.delta_effect: delta effect: must produce ΔⁿB and/or Δκ field-state update

closure.positive_target: agent execution field oriented toward N_fiṭrī ∧ ʿaql ṣarīḥ

coupling.meaning: language-mediated coupling attempt from the agent execution field toward the diagnosed interlocutor field
negative_constraints: does not assert access to the soul
does not claim the agent controls guidance

control_effects.route_selection: ∇ ranks eligible burden/route pressure after owner gates constrain the candidate set.
control_effects.loop_breaking: Nonzero ∇×T must trigger loop-breaker eligibility, HOLD, RECURSE, or PARTIAL instead of false closure.
control_effects.closure: 𝒞(Ψᴺ) permits STOP only when residual pressure is cleared, integrated, discharged, held, or carried forward.
control_effects.coupling: Restorative Response is evaluated as a language-mediated coupling attempt, not as proof of interlocutor uptake.
control_effects.reread: R(H,Delta) rereads the whole live field after each transition and any loop-breaking submove.
control_effects.partial_behavior: Unresolved divergence/curl or unsafe coupling claims force PARTIAL/RECURSE.

forbidden_claims: Ψᴵ gives access to the soul
expected_blocker: Field-operator architecture blocks Delta replacement, gate bypass, arbitrary loop-breaking, conversion guarantees, soul-access claims, and guidance-control claims.

ir_projection.collapse_radius: closure remains live until route-gradient-selected burden, Delta event, field diagnostics, loop-break eligibility, and R(H,Delta) reread are accounted
ir_projection.what_is_withheld_and_why: Default governed render may print compact route-gradient, LoopBreak, closure, and coupling markers only when they are control-bound; long explanation remains audit/formalism-expanded.
